raw.text:
To submit or validate an activity proposal, you need to provide the following four required pieces of information:

1. **Title**: The proposed title of the Activity Proposal.
2. **Description**: A description of the Activity Proposal.
3. **Managed Geography**: The managed geography to which the proposal belongs.
4. **Assessment Unit ID**: The exact ID of the Assessment Unit the proposal belongs to.

All of these fields must contain usable values (i.e., they cannot be empty or consist only of whitespace).
